div.p: Build powerful Odoo solutions tailored around your business processes, operational requirements, and industry-specific workflows. We develop custom modules, features, integrations, and business logic that extend Odoo beyond its standard capabilities while keeping the system structured and maintainable.

From a single custom feature to a complete ERP ecosystem, our Odoo development approach focuses on clean architecture, reliable performance, and long-term scalability. We work across Odoo modules and workflows to create solutions that fit naturally into your existing operations.

Launch scalable SaaS products powered by Odoo with customized workflows, user experiences, subscription management, and multi-company capabilities. We help transform Odoo into a centralized platform that can support multiple customers, organizations, or business environments.

Our development approach covers the technical foundation required for a reliable SaaS platform, including tenant management, automation, access control, integrations, and custom application functionality. The result is an Odoo-based SaaS environment built around your product and commercial model.

Extend your development capacity with experienced Odoo developers who can work alongside your internal team or take ownership of specific Odoo projects. Whether you need short-term development support or dedicated technical resources, we provide developers familiar with Odoo customization, integrations, modules, and business workflows.

Our developers can adapt to your existing architecture, development practices, and project requirements. From implementing new features and resolving technical issues to maintaining and extending existing modules, you get focused Odoo development support without the overhead of building an entirely new team.

Build modern digital experiences using Odoo as the business and ERP backend while separating the presentation layer from the core application. Our headless Odoo development services connect customized frontends with Odoo through APIs and structured data flows.

This architecture gives businesses greater flexibility when building ecommerce platforms, customer portals, mobile experiences, and specialized applications. We design the integration layer to keep data synchronized while allowing the frontend experience to evolve independently from the Odoo backend.

Implement Odoo around the way your organization actually operates. We help businesses configure applications, workflows, users, permissions, automation, and integrations while aligning the ERP environment with their operational requirements.

A successful implementation goes beyond installing modules. We work through business processes, data requirements, custom functionality, and system configuration to create an environment that teams can use effectively. Our goal is to establish a strong foundation that can continue to evolve as your business grows.

Extend your Odoo environment to mobile devices with applications designed around the needs of employees, customers, sales teams, field workers, and other users. We develop mobile experiences that connect with Odoo data and workflows while keeping everyday tasks simple and accessible.

From mobile sales and inventory operations to customer portals and specialized business applications, we can create experiences that work alongside your existing ERP. Integrations are designed to keep important information synchronized between mobile applications and your Odoo environment.

Customize Odoo Point of Sale workflows to support the way your retail, hospitality, restaurant, or service business operates. We develop POS features, interfaces, integrations, and business logic that extend the standard Odoo POS experience.

Custom pricing rules, payment integrations, inventory workflows, receipts, customer management, and third-party systems can be connected into the POS environment. We focus on creating a reliable checkout experience while ensuring POS activity remains connected with the wider Odoo ecosystem.

Improve the search visibility of Odoo websites and ecommerce platforms with SEO-focused technical and content improvements. We work with website structures, metadata, URLs, page content, technical configuration, and other elements that influence how search engines understand your website.

Our approach combines Odoo-specific technical knowledge with practical SEO requirements. We help create a cleaner site structure, optimize important landing pages, and ensure that your Odoo website provides a stronger foundation for organic search growth.

Create distinctive Odoo websites with custom themes designed around your brand identity, content structure, and user experience. We develop responsive layouts, reusable components, navigation systems, landing pages, and visual elements that work within the Odoo website environment.

Custom theme development also gives your team greater control over how the website evolves. We can build structured SCSS, templates, components, and frontend interactions that maintain consistency across pages while providing the flexibility needed for future content and functionality.

Develop dedicated Odoo applications when your business requirements go beyond the functionality available in standard modules. Custom applications can introduce new workflows, data structures, automation, dashboards, user interfaces, and integrations tailored specifically to your operations.

We build custom apps with a focus on maintainability and integration with the wider Odoo environment. This allows new functionality to work alongside existing sales, accounting, inventory, CRM, website, and other business processes instead of becoming an isolated system.

Connect Odoo with shipping providers and build customized delivery workflows around your logistics requirements. We develop shipping methods that can handle carrier integrations, delivery rules, pricing logic, tracking information, and order fulfillment processes.

Custom shipping functionality can help businesses manage complex delivery conditions across different products, locations, carriers, and customer types. We integrate these processes directly into Odoo so that order management, fulfillment, and shipment information remain connected.

Get practical guidance on how Odoo can support your business processes, technical architecture, integrations, and future growth. Our consulting services help identify the right Odoo applications, customization requirements, workflow improvements, and technical approaches for your environment.

We can support organizations at different stages, from initial planning and solution design to existing Odoo optimization and technical assessments. The focus is on understanding your requirements first and then translating them into a clear, implementable Odoo strategy.

Adapt standard Odoo functionality to match the specific processes and requirements of your organization. We customize views, workflows, reports, business rules, automation, permissions, and application behavior without forcing your teams to change established processes unnecessarily.

Our customization work is designed to fit into your existing Odoo ecosystem while keeping future maintenance in mind. Whether the requirement is a focused modification or a broader workflow change, we structure the solution around usability, reliability, and compatibility with the rest of your ERP.

Build product information management workflows in Odoo to organize, enrich, maintain, and distribute product data across your business channels. We can customize product structures, attributes, categories, specifications, media, and related information around your catalog requirements.

A structured PIM environment helps teams maintain consistent product information while reducing repetitive data management. We connect product information with ecommerce, sales, inventory, and other Odoo processes so that product data remains centralized and easier to manage.

Move your Odoo environment to a newer version or a new technical setup while preserving important business data and workflows. We assess the existing database, custom modules, integrations, and configurations before planning the migration process.

Migration projects often involve more than transferring database records. Customizations, third-party applications, dependencies, and historical data all need to be considered. We structure migrations carefully to reduce disruption and provide a stable foundation for continued Odoo development after the upgrade.

Connect Odoo with the other platforms your business relies on, including ecommerce systems, marketplaces, CRM platforms, logistics providers, payment services, and internal applications. We design integrations that allow systems to exchange the data required for day-to-day operations.

Our integration work focuses on reliable data synchronization, structured APIs, automation, error handling, and clear business workflows. The objective is to reduce manual data entry and create a connected technology environment where Odoo can serve as a central operational platform.

Keep your Odoo environment stable, secure, and ready for ongoing business requirements with dedicated support and maintenance. We assist with bug fixes, technical issues, module updates, configuration changes, performance concerns, and ongoing development requirements.

Continuous maintenance also helps prevent small technical issues from becoming larger operational problems. Our team can work with your existing Odoo implementation to resolve issues, improve functionality, and support the system as your business processes continue to evolve.

Develop and customize Odoo marketplace solutions for businesses managing multiple vendors, sellers, products, orders, and marketplace operations. We can extend marketplace functionality to support vendor workflows, commissions, product management, order processing, and platform-specific requirements.

Whether you are building a marketplace from the ground up or extending an existing Odoo marketplace environment, we can customize the platform around your operational model. Integrations with payments, shipping, inventory, and other services can also be incorporated into the overall marketplace workflow.

Integrate payment providers and create customized payment workflows within Odoo. We work with payment APIs and Odoo payment flows to connect transactions with ecommerce, sales, subscriptions, and other business processes.

Custom payment development can include payment initiation, transaction handling, callbacks, status synchronization, refunds, and related order updates. The integration is structured to keep payment information connected with the appropriate Odoo records and workflows.

Transition business processes and data from Salesforce into Odoo with a structured migration strategy. We can help map existing customer, sales, CRM, and related business information to the appropriate Odoo models and workflows.

A Salesforce-to-Odoo migration also provides an opportunity to redesign processes around the Odoo ecosystem instead of simply copying an existing system. We focus on data mapping, migration preparation, custom requirements, integrations, and validation so that the new environment is ready for day-to-day business use.
Four stages, no surprises halfway through.
We map your current processes across sales, inventory, accounting, and HR to figure out exactly which modules and customizations you need, and which you don't.
Core modules get configured to your business rules. Anything a stock module can't do gets built as a clean, upgrade-safe custom module.
Historical data is cleaned, mapped, and migrated. We run the new setup in parallel against real scenarios before anyone relies on it.
A structured cutover, hands-on training for your team, and support on standby for the first weeks of real-world use.
